headline: Supplementary budget passes to the Executive Power passes to the Executive
summary: A bill amending the 2026 General State Budget passed the Senate with 23 votes in favor and one against, and now moves to the executive. It adds 54,100 million pesos in spending and raises the fiscal deficit from 3.24% to 4.2% of GDP.
why: The fiscal deficit and spending plans shape government borrowing needs, sovereign debt metrics and the outlook for the Dominican peso and its bonds.
original_headline: Presupuesto complementario pasa al Poder Ejecutivo pasa al Ejecutivo
